title: Mobilityaid Metric0 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mobilityaid:metric0 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in mobilityaid metric0 events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme mobilityaid metric0 records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It scans the unusually high or low value moments in your mobilityaid metric0 history.
